value.signature: fn target (& self , label : & NamespaceLabel) -> Option < Coordinate >

review.body: { let (major , line) = self . lines . get (label) ? . iter () . next_back () ? ; let (minor , _) = line . entries . last () ? ; Some (Coordinate :: new (label . clone () , * major , * minor)) }
review.item_premise: This body inherits the public-interchange decision for registry::Registry::target.
